ios.desc:
Get ready for an adventure in solving over 200+ puzzling! You can take the role of a detective or narrator in complex scenarios. The solution of the riddles lies somewhere in the dark and in the extraordinary.

From puzzling crimes to inexplicable events, using only the clues provided by the narrator. But be warned, these aren’t your average brain teasers; they’re tests of logic and creativity that will keep you guessing until the very end.

Gather your friends and family for an exciting game night, since the app requires at least 2 players. There is no maximum amount of players! With every twist and turn, Black Stories invites you to stretch your imagination, question assumptions, and unlock the secrets that lie beneath the surface. 

Perfect for parties and gatherings, this app challenges you to put on your detective hat and guess the solution to various situational riddles. Each black story presents a unique lateral thinking puzzle that will train your brain and test your detective skills. Black Stories offers endless entertainment for those who love to guess and solve complex scenarios.

Join the ranks of the best detectives with Black Stories, the app that combines dark stories with challenging puzzles. Think outside the box to solve the most complex puzzles. The following features are inside the app:

- Over 150+ riddles completely free
- Unique never-seen before riddles
- Beautiful artwork for each riddle
- Updated monthly with new scenarios
- Real-time statistics for each riddle, compare your score to many others
- Favorite your riddles to organize them and quickly find them again
- Like your favorite story and mark them as solved to get quick insight in which situational puzzles you still need to solve

Black Stories is a yes/no game, where you can be a detective or a narrator! If you are a detective, you can only ask yes or no questions to the narrator, and vice versa!

What are you waiting for? Download the app now!

quotes.text:
Hey everybody,

I launched Black Stories and I am searching for feedback! The app is a party game and build for 2 or more players and is available on both iOS and Android. Check it out:

- Website: black-stories.com
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/black-stories-dark-puzzles/id6496355986
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blackstories.blackriddles

In Black Stories, players can choose to be detectives or narrators. The game has over 200 free puzzles.

One player reads a riddle out loud while keeping the solution secret. The rest of the group will then use yes/no questions to try to uncover the answer.

I’d love to hear your feedback, so give it a shot and let me know what you think!
